description: This file defines the WorkDay class which provides methods to calculate dates adjusted by working days, excluding weekends and holidays, similar to Excel's WORKDAY function.

classes.name: WorkDay
classes.description: A class providing methods to calculate workday dates, similar to Excel's WORKDAY function, considering weekends and holidays.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Calculates a workday date offset by a specified number of working days, considering holidays.
parameters: startDate: The initial date, in various formats
endDays: Number of working days to add or subtract
dateArgs: Optional list of holiday dates to exclude

methods.name: incrementing
methods.description: Implements logic to increment the date by working days, skipping weekends and holidays.

methods.name: incrementingArray
methods.description: Adjusts the end date by accounting for holidays falling within the date range.

methods.name: decrementing
methods.description: Implements logic to decrement the date by working days, skipping weekends and holidays.

methods.name: decrementingArray
methods.description: Adjusts the end date by accounting for holidays within the range during decrementing.

methods.name: getWeekDay
methods.description: Returns the day of the week for a given date.
